card.name: Start of 'adrenal' in corticosteroid warnings
card.fires_on: The opening piece 'Ad' of 'adrenal' (as in adrenal suppression or insufficiency) in corticosteroid label headings and warnings. It also fires weakly on the start of steroid names like betamethasone valerate.

modes.label: Adrenal heading
modes.description: The 'Ad' that begins 'adrenal' after 'Hypercorticism and' or 'HPA Suppression/' in warning section titles.

modes.label: Steroid name pieces
modes.description: Break points inside or beside corticosteroid product names and strengths.

card.plain: It marks the start of the word 'adrenal' in steroid warning headings about adrenal suppression.
